author_premises_preserved.statement: RRR is a post-apocalyptic nuclear-wasteland hobby and racing world.
Rad roaches assimilate parts from other insects; the biological premise is fictional.
The founding rivalry escalates from beetle horn to mantis pincers to grasshopper jumping legs, with the jumper winning the race.
The mature circuit setting is thirty years after the founding-rivalry era.
Locals lead to Regionals, then Factionals, then faction representation in New World City for the What’s Left of the World Derby.
Open is the most famous competitive class and embraces no-holds-barred builds; entry to the world championship still requires qualification.
The All-Out Offensive circuit requires a minimum offensive build and light carapace.
Speedsters prohibit weapon modules, while native violence and contact can occur.
The world mirrors PCR’s build-and-race hobby, with its own execution and identity in the sense of Mutant League’s relationship to conventional sport.
Speed, race victories, desirable upgrades, collecting, personal assembly and showing off are legitimate central pleasures.
A Wrangloid is a successful insect-catching and breeding hobbyist who turns that success into a livelihood.
Wrangloid shops resemble fish stores, with whole living insects varying in rarity, quality and price.
Anyone may search for, catch and breed insects. Expertise and discovery matter; this is not a profession-exclusive permission.
RRR is a large sandbox with accessible participation and optional depth for advanced users.
Racing remains racing; the user did not specify last-roach-standing races.
Foundational development proceeds in revisable waves using rigorous distinct statements, not story exposition.
Targeted wildland collection, selective breeding, tanks, selling unwanted stock and earned recurring livelihoods are central connected gameplay systems.
Mewgenics is a benchmark for successful consequential breeding/progression design, not permission to invent its exact mechanics.

amendments.title: Current desk edition, not chronological scavenging
amendments.problem: Relevant meaning is scattered across nested volumes and later amendments.
amendments.current_definition: Use the current desk edition and scoped resolution register; retrieve deeper monographs through direct subject routes.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A developer can get the applicable answer without merging all old experiments.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Broad unresolved tags no longer imply no developed answer
amendments.problem: Initial broad decisions remain unresolved even where later subquestions have substantial definitions.
amendments.current_definition: Keep original decisions, add subquestion status and exact current routes; unresolved author choices remain visible.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Prevents both false completeness and unnecessary reinvention.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Condition is not genotype or quality band
amendments.problem: Current performance, material state and inherited promise can be collapsed into one quality field.
amendments.current_definition: Separate developed anatomy, inherited contribution, material, supply, fit and evidence.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: An extraordinary but injured specimen remains an intelligible breeding or restoration decision.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Actual source roles survive repair
amendments.problem: A generic repair action could refill, align, damp and heal every subsystem together.
amendments.current_definition: Restore the named function through actual inputs; preserve drive, leverage, contact, sensing, compliance and damping.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A service has a purpose and cannot fix an unrelated bottleneck.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: The Return Bench closes the setback
amendments.problem: Post-event definitions often stop at a state or quote.
amendments.current_definition: Follow result, returned material, meaningful assessment, chosen route and verified return or other disposition.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A setback creates a manageable decision without forcing a breeding reset.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Routine exchange is not another per-click cost chain
amendments.problem: New material and receiving detail can silently recreate separately charged compulsory appointments.
amendments.current_definition: Bundle ordinary service into declared allowances; only performed extra work changes scope.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: The growing atlas does not make ordinary kit use increasingly burdensome.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Repair is neither universally complete nor necessarily permanently inferior
amendments.problem: Healed appearance can be mistaken for original strength; repair can also be assigned an invented permanent penalty.
amendments.current_definition: Assess the achieved working envelope. Full useful restoration is possible where supported; partial restoration is labeled.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Meaningful material consequences coexist with desirable long-lived projects.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Material state does not rank every mechanical property together
amendments.problem: Stiffness or hardness alone can be mistaken for superior stock.
amendments.current_definition: Name condition and required measurement; avoid a universal dry/hard/better rule.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A catcher and breeder can ask the correct question instead of selecting damaged stock.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Original core and replacement interface remain separate
amendments.problem: A restoration can be read as an entirely new object or a magically unchanged original.
amendments.current_definition: Record retained material, supplied replacement and achieved current function; preserve host and historical configuration.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Restoration, display and working use can coexist honestly.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Recovery does not duplicate rare material
amendments.problem: A living integration premise could be used to regenerate unlimited paid cores.
amendments.current_definition: Ordinary maintenance preserves or repairs the identified material. Regeneration needs an approved profile and actual inputs.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Breeding and collecting remain meaningful without universal fragility.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Loss, maneuver failure, retirement and injury are different
amendments.problem: A failed action or course-out could become an arbitrary whole-animal death or full-damage state.
amendments.current_definition: Record those four outcomes independently with actual affected anatomy and published event procedures.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Racing stays finish-first while contact has intelligible consequences.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: A supported specimen may remain a poor immediate part but useful stock
amendments.problem: Local damage can incorrectly zero all breeding, display and residual material value.
amendments.current_definition: Evaluate remaining actual capabilities and market purpose separately; do not guarantee fertility or buyers.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Keep-good/sell-unwanted has more than one sensible criterion.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Production reliability is measured under actual care and preparation
amendments.problem: Useful material yield can be entirely attributed to genes despite different handling.
amendments.current_definition: Separate family evidence from facility, case and preparation effects; preserve uncertainty about future output.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Breeders and fitters receive credit for different real contributions.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Thirty foundation parts plus explicit later preparations
amendments.problem: A thirty-item index alone can conceal the later complete-flight preparation requirements.
amendments.current_definition: Keep the thirty founding entries and add four explicit preparation supplements, without counting them as new donor species.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A complete Flyer bill cannot lose yoke, support or flight-drive meaning.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: A product declares continued use, not just sale acceptance
amendments.problem: A correct first delivery can leave normal rematching and support unclear.
amendments.current_definition: State ordinary exchange support, replaceable boundaries, material requirements and separately quoted exceptions.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: The buyer receives an approachable project and a legible next service route.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Repair demand is not manufactured to balance shops
amendments.problem: A service career could depend on compulsory damage after every race.
amendments.current_definition: Demand follows actual use, change and care alongside new projects; matched cost/price review remains required.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: Financial viability cannot be purchased by making the core racing loop deliberately irritating.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Positive margin and financing are independent
amendments.problem: A future fee can disguise insufficient cash before work begins.
amendments.current_definition: Keep opening capital, receipt timing, actual outlays and paid operator work distinct; requote before extra commitment.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: No invisible overdraft or retrospective reimbursement explains a successful commission.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Representation survives recovery without host duplication
amendments.problem: A damaged qualifying host can confuse the entrant’s earned rights with an in-meet host swap.
amendments.current_definition: Retain separate entrant, host, build and seat; apply the published meeting boundary for refits/replacements.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A stable supports a campaign without turning purchased champions into purchased qualifications.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: Physical collection remains meaningful after a changed function
amendments.problem: Current race usefulness can become the only recognized reason to keep an object.
amendments.current_definition: Define working spare, restored original, display, partial use and replica through actual identity and consent.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: A finished personal project need not be sold or destroyed to justify its existence.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.

amendments.title: The next milestone is experience evidence, not more nominal passes
amendments.problem: Document counts and historical test totals can masquerade as validated quality.
amendments.current_definition: Separate editorial integrity from later observed comprehension, meaningful choice, actual cost and voluntary reuse.
amendments.effect_on_play_or_authoring: MIVIM effectiveness and quality claims remain bounded to evidence actually gathered.
amendments.history_policy: Earlier inputs/results remain unchanged. This interpretation replaces only the named scope.
